statement: For every ordinary subset A of {1,...,127}, if there do not exist three pairwise distinct x,y,z in A with gcd(x,y)=gcd(x,z)=gcd(y,z), then |A|<=16; equality is attained by {14,20,21,24,25,30,36,40,48,63,80,90,96,98,108,125}. Hence the frozen original quantity satisfies f3(127)=16.
contribution: A direct exact finite resolution independent of the cited N=126 lead: exhaustive definition-level forbidden-triple clauses plus an exact at-least-17 cardinality encoding have a verified DRAT refutation, while an explicit 16-element witness passes all 560 triple checks. No novelty claim is made because the supplied SSRN full text was inaccessible.
